name: Chamaeleon
introduction: is the Chameleon, introduced by Dutch navigators in the 1590s. It lies near the south celestial pole.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: The [Chamaeleon clouds](id:cahlon-cloud-20), about 500 light-years away, are among the nearest star-forming regions, giving birth to young stars.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Alpha Chamaeleontis](hip:40702) is a white star 64 light-years away. [Gamma Chamaeleontis](hip:51839) and [Beta Chamaeleontis](hip:60000) are an orange giant and a blue star.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Chamaeleon contains the planetary nebula NGC 3195.
